name: Stochastic Laplacian Path Tracing
definition: Accelerates rendering by stochastically deciding which frequency bands (pyramid levels) of the Gabor asset to integrate for each path segment, trading variance for reduced traversal time.
summary: Stochastic Laplacian Path Tracing accelerates volume rendering by stochastically selecting frequency bands for integration, reducing ray-primitive intersections to speed up high-frequency content rendering.
